title.vi: CASE, NULL và hàm tiện ích

summary.vi: CASE WHEN, COALESCE, hàm chuỗi, số và ngày giờ
summary.en: CASE WHEN, COALESCE, string, number and date functions

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
SELECT
  name,
  price,
  CASE
    WHEN price >= 5000000 THEN 'premium'
    WHEN price >= 1000000 THEN 'standard'
    ELSE 'budget'
  END AS tier
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC;

prompt.vi: Thêm cột tier cho products bằng CASE: price >= 5000000 → 'premium', >= 1000000 → 'standard', còn lại 'budget'. Trả về hai cột name và tier.
prompt.en: Add a tier column to products using CASE: price >= 5000000 → 'premium', >= 1000000 → 'standard', otherwise 'budget'. Return two columns name and tier.

hint.vi: CASE WHEN price >= 5000000 THEN 'premium' WHEN price >= 1000000 THEN 'standard' ELSE 'budget' END AS tier
hint.en: CASE WHEN price >= 5000000 THEN 'premium' WHEN price >= 1000000 THEN 'standard' ELSE 'budget' END AS tier

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT name,
  CASE
    WHEN price >= 5000000 THEN 'premium'
    WHEN price >= 1000000 THEN 'standard'
    ELSE 'budget'
  END AS tier
FROM products;

label.vi: Laptop là premium, Desk là standard, Pen là budget
label.en: Laptop is premium, Desk standard, Pen budget

prompt.en: Show customers' name and email, replacing a NULL email with the text 'no email' (use COALESCE).

hint.vi: SELECT name, COALESCE(email, 'no email') AS email FROM customers;
